title: Package pages and package READMEs
goal: docs/packages/<pkg>/index.md для core, catalog, inventory, pricing, promotions, shipping, sales, testkit, full и packages/<pkg>/README.md

checks.cmd: for p in core catalog inventory pricing promotions shipping sales testkit full; do test -f docs/packages/$p/index.md && test -f packages/$p/README.md || exit 1; done

instructions: Структура страницы — rules item P8.6; ключи конфига из packages/<pkg>/config/*.php; команды и plugin ID — assembly-design#baseline; ссылка на ../../reference/api/<pkg>.md.

outcome.notes: unit work reviewed by the integrator; item checks V1-V5 green
